question: Select the INCORRECTLY spelt word.
solution:
The correct answer is: **Option 2**.

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/36f36cd5ece4186095afcf2ffbfb7b80cc04b6c2e3226e7477a419a9fbc96f85.png] **__Key Points__**

__
 
• The word **"Maintenence"** is incorrectly spelled. The correct spelling is **"Maintenance"**.
 
• Meaning of "Maintenence" (incorrect spelling): It is supposed to mean the process of keeping something in good condition, but the spelling is wrong. (रखरखाव)
 
 
• **Example:** The maintenence of the building was scheduled, but the notice had a spelling error.
 
 
 
• Correct word: **"Maintenance"** (रखरखाव)
 
 
• **Example:** Regular maintenance of your car ensures it runs smoothly for years.
 
 
 
• Hence, the word "Maintenence" is incorrect, and the correct spelling is "Maintenance".

Therefore, the correct answer is: **Option 2**.

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/f13e2ad6582c16aa62a83672e2547ad20a01fddb61962a1acce42eb9a1a99caa.png] **Additional Information__**

Here are the other options explained along with their Hindi meanings and example sentences:

 
• **Necessary** (आवश्यक): Something that is required or essential.

 
 
• **Example:** It is necessary to bring your ID card to the event.
 
 
 
• **Embarrassment** (शर्मिंदगी): A feeling of self-consciousness, shame, or awkwardness.
 
 
• **Example:** She felt a deep sense of embarrassment when she forgot her speech.
 
 
 
• **Inadvertent** (अनजाने में): Something that happens unintentionally or without planning.
 
 
• **Example:** His inadvertent mistake caused a delay in the project.
